avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces ubrogepant plasma concentration and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; consider alternative supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin (herbal equivalent)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction significantly decreases ubrogepant exposure
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue herbal CYP3A4 inducers before ubrogepant therapy

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase ubrogepant levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; limit consumption

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction may reduce ubrogepant efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and monitor migraine control

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase ubrogepant plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption or avoid; prefer other citrus beverages

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay ubrogepant absorption and onset of migraine relief
caution_foods.action: Take ubrogepant on empty stomach or with light meal for optimal efficacy

monitoring_notes: Ubrogepant is primarily metabolized via CYP3A4; monitor for loss of efficacy with CYP3A4 inducers and increased adverse effects with CYP3A4 inhibitors. Counsel patients to maintain consistent supplement and dietary patterns and report any changes in migraine control.
